name: technical-grid
title: Animated Technical Grid
description: Hairline engineering grid with major lines, corner registration marks, a scanning line and pulsing intersection nodes. Reads as a calm blueprint with motion off.

props.description: A div that paints the grid behind its children. Extends every div prop.

props.name: tone
props.description: Line intensity and ink color. clay tints lines, scan line and nodes with the accent.

props.name: fade
props.description: Masks the field so the grid dissolves toward the edges or one side.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Minor cell size in px. Clamped between 8 and 160.

props.name: majorEvery
props.description: Every Nth line is drawn stronger. 0 or 1 disables major lines.

props.name: scan
props.description: Direction of the sweeping scan line.

props.name: scanDuration
props.description: Seconds per sweep. Clamped between 1 and 60.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Count of pulsing intersection nodes, snapped to grid lines. Maximum 24.

props.name: markers
props.description: Draws registration marks in the four corners.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono caption pinned to the top left.

props.name: caption
props.description: Mono caption pinned to the bottom right.

props.name: animated
props.description: Turns the scan line and node pulses off while keeping the static grid.

variants.name: tone
variants.description: Foreground ink at 6 and 12 percent, 10 and 22 percent, or the clay accent.

variants.name: fade
variants.description: Radial or linear mask applied to the grid field only, never to children.

examples.title: Grid as a framed field
examples.description: Content sits above the grid in a relatively positioned wrapper.

examples.title: Grid as a section background
examples.description: Absolutely positioned behind content with an edge fade and both scan axes.

accessibility: The grid, scan line, nodes and corner marks are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events, so they never enter the accessibility tree or block clicks.
Nothing meaningful is encoded in the grid. label and caption are real text in text-muted-foreground, which stays above 4.5:1 on the card and background tokens.
Children render above the grid in normal DOM order and keep their own semantics and focus order.
With prefers-reduced-motion the scan line and node pulses are hidden. The static grid, nodes and marks remain, so the composition is complete with all motion off.

animation.properties: transform (translate) and opacity, composited on the GPU
animation.timing: scanDuration seconds, linear, infinite. Vertical scan starts half a cycle later so both axes never align.
animation.trigger: Starts on mount and loops without interaction.

animation.timing: 3 to 5 seconds per node, ease-out, infinite, delays staggered up to 4 seconds.
animation.trigger: Starts on mount and loops without interaction.
animation.reducedMotion: Ring hidden. The solid node dot stays.
